body:
FND-01 prerequisite is satisfied by the owner-approved PR #1 merge `2215a91511a53601464eef46d383cd3557cfa3a8`. FND-02 is now claimed In progress.

Source evidence PR: https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/51
Branch: `fnd-02/source-evidence`

All eleven owned forks have full-history clones and verified local Git bundles (10.812 GiB total). The PR records actual IDs, commits, hashes, 46 retained license/notice records and 127 inherited workflow references. Observed donor defaults are acquisition snapshots, not approved product baselines.

Specific unresolved work: GeoNode GPL v2-or-later header alongside GPLv3 full text; GeoTools selected-file license scope; GeoNode floating MapStore `master.zip` and GeoServer `2.28.x-latest`; dependency/toolchain closure; workflow/package namespace audit; stable tuple selection and real smoke tests. No binary branding/license decision has been made.

A separate local PostgreSQL worktree is probing the exact owned candidate commit. Default configure and build succeeded; actual regression tests are still running. This is feasibility evidence with unretained host inputs, not FND-08 acceptance.

Owned PostgreSQL feasibility probe completed: source `c62b330912e2095dc8dee2f749adf7e5d94ca611` on local branch `fnd-02/postgresql-build`; default configure and `make -j4` succeeded; `make -j4 check` passed 239 actual core regression tests with zero failures/skip markers. The temporary test cluster shut down cleanly and source stayed unmodified.

The executable, dependency and log hashes are in PR #51 (`plan/verification/postgresql-candidate-build.json`). This 20devel snapshot is not an approved baseline; host toolchain/dependency closure is unretained. PostGIS integration, AmbisGIS branch authorization/concurrency/recovery and upstream-disconnected repair have not run. FND-02/FND-08 remain incomplete.

FND-02 remains **In progress**. [PR #51](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/51), branch `fnd-02/source-evidence`, is now at `b68efb58b9ddb139f98c3f460e65f06c2573a668` and includes the approved GOV-01 base.

Evidence now includes eleven verified full-history Git bundles (10.812 GiB), preserved license/notice provenance, a nine-component candidate tuple derived from retained source declarations, and real owned PostgreSQL probes: 239 core tests on the acquisition snapshot and 217 on proposed 15.19 commit `2ff1375b5dd8bf09d8cb0e795974528180fd75ca`. Both core suites passed with no failure/skip markers and temporary clusters shut down. The branch's 143 package/governance tests and strict plan/schema checks also passed from the documented `plan/` directory.

PostGIS 3.5.7 was not built or tested. Read-only input audit found GEOS, PROJ, GDAL, protobuf-c/protoc-c, json-c and CUnit development inputs missing from inspected host paths. Available staged PostgreSQL development files are recorded. The next ready task is to retain/audit those sources and transitive inputs, build into a local prefix, select the full PostgreSQL feature profile, then run actual PostGIS extension/raster/MVT/GeoJSON/install/upgrade checks. Do not let optional configure warnings silently omit required features/tests.

No complete tuple, license decision, canonical donor baseline, dependency closure, disconnected rebuild/repair, P1 journey or release is accepted by this evidence. FND-07/FND-08 stay Backlog pending their dependencies; source-fork defaults remain unchanged. GOV-01 is now Merged; GOV-02 stays separately Blocked on saved-view verification.

Completed the bounded owned PostgreSQL 15.19 / PostGIS 3.5.7 engineering slice for review in [PR #51](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/51), head `1c3a9b7f85c45cb8f00ac2ebe70041b2fbd755b9` on `fnd-02/source-evidence`. Implementation code is `9c8b32bcce74870473d947d2ed6810b6c5041e2f`.

- Retained/audited 20 archives and 93 original notices; reproducible acquisition/build/validation recipes are committed. Exact owned PostgreSQL/PostGIS candidates remain unchanged.
- Fresh network-denied build passed 217 PostgreSQL core + 1 fuzzystrmatch tests; target PostGIS CUnit passed 413 tests / 51,347 assertions.
- Native SQL source and installed-extension modes each passed 672 tests, with zero failures/skips.
- Genuine retained PostGIS 3.5.6→3.5.7 upgrade preserved geometry/raster/topology witnesses: 39 old/upgraded/fresh checks passed, plus 13 final linkage-guard smoke checks. All own clusters stopped.
- Current tooling checks passed 175 package tests, 22 harness tests and all four schema checks. Dependency omissions, historical failures, host/toolchain gaps, command/log/artifact hashes and seven successful offline receipts are retained in [slice evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/1c3a9b7f85c45cb8f00ac2ebe70041b2fbd755b9/plan/docs/postgis-slice-evidence.md).

FND-02 stays **In progress**. This does not approve production baselines/licenses/security, complete the remaining owned tuple, accept FND-07/FND-08, or authorize P1. GOV-02 remains separately Blocked on saved-view UI verification; Project values and human discussion were preserved. PR #51 remains open and unmerged for owner review.

Next ready FND-02 action: inspect retained JupyterHub/JupyterLab candidate/runtime declarations, then continue the Java/client dependency closure and integration work. [Exact resumption commands and retained paths](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/1c3a9b7f85c45cb8f00ac2ebe70041b2fbd755b9/plan/docs/postgis-slice-handoff.md).

Continuing the authorized bounded Jupyter candidate/runtime slice on separate branch `fnd-02/jupyter-runtime` from verified PR #51 merge `a3c2e2e696ea11bdc10c2ad202a240fbd0137f45`. PR #51's reviewed head is preserved. FND-02 remains In progress; the database merge accepts that development checkpoint only.

Acceptance for this slice: resolve exact owned Hub/Lab candidates; retain source/build/runtime inputs with hashes and notices; build both packages and required frontend assets; demonstrate retained-input rebuild/install plus real loopback notebook/kernel/save/reopen/shutdown tests, and a safe unprivileged Hub path where feasible. Record native failures/skips and host custody gaps explicitly. No production isolation, full notebook/P6, canonical-baseline, license, FND-07/FND-08 or P1 acceptance is implied.

GOV-02 owner evidence is being reconciled independently in a separate reviewable change; it does not block these builds. No PR merge is authorized or planned.

Completed the bounded owned Jupyter candidate/runtime slice for review in [PR #53](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/53). Branch `fnd-02/jupyter-runtime`, verified remote/PR head `d1b39132c1b003f354589026a7e211021aac1c56`; implemented/tested code `ee6d2d135fd64e1b9ad5372bd0506fa077af4456`. Base is PR #51's actual owner merge `a3c2e2e696ea11bdc10c2ad202a240fbd0137f45`; its frozen feature head was preserved.

- Owned Hub 6.0.1 and Lab 4.6.3 were built with their frontend assets from the exact recorded owned commits. Real Hub startup exposed missing archive package data, now explicitly preserved and verified. Separate Hub/user environments use the owned wheels.
- Retained 5,510 inputs /817,990,927 bytes, 146 Python distributions with corresponding sdists, npm/Yarn inputs and 3,522 original notice records. Source-built packages, retained binaries, third-party repair sources and unretained host dependencies remain distinguished.
- Final clean build passed 24 top-level commands with Internet sockets denied. Local source-built PAM import libraries required no host authentication changes.
- **329 selected native tests passed without failures/skips.** Two fresh-state standalone and Hub/proxy/singleuser probes passed exact wheel/418-asset origins, token rejection, real kernel execution, notebook save/reopen and orderly shutdown. Observed listeners were loopback; no processes/private credential directories remain.
- **20 Jupyter harness +22 database harness +175 package tests and all four schemas passed.** The database native build was not repeated. Exploratory failures and the broad linkage scan's unused musl-binary diagnostic remain retained; actual glibc loader selection succeeded.

FND-02 stays **In progress**. This is a development checkpoint, not canonical baseline/license/production-security approval or FND-07/FND-08/P1/P6 acceptance. Host/toolchain and full third-party repair closure remain incomplete. The same-user fixture does not establish multiuser isolation, production SSO, browser acceptance, quotas, scheduling or spatial profiles; external runtime egress isolation was not tested.

Please review PR #53 as that bounded checkpoint. [Full evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/d1b39132c1b003f354589026a7e211021aac1c56/plan/docs/jupyter-slice-evidence.md), [machine receipts](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/d1b39132c1b003f354589026a7e211021aac1c56/plan/verification/jupyter-slice.json), and [exact resume instructions/owner actions](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/d1b39132c1b003f354589026a7e211021aac1c56/plan/docs/jupyter-slice-handoff.md) are committed.

Next ready FND-02 action: separately claim the Java rendering dependency audit (GeoTools → GeoWebCache → GeoServer and required GeoNode extensions), then client/MapStore and QGIS according to the actual dependency graph. GOV-02 reconciliation is separate in PR #52 with two precise owner view checks outstanding. Neither PR was merged. No Project settings/progress, inherited workflow, secret, source-fork default, deployment or release changed.

Claiming the next bounded FND-02 Java rendering dependency audit on `fnd-02/java-dependency-audit`, worktree `ambisgis-platform-java`, from current `ambisgis/main` at `12bd2c5c88ab8573add1b483f1d53b4024649b39`. GitHub confirms owner `aloerch` merged Jupyter PR #53 at that commit; its reviewed branch and retained runs are preserved. FND-02 remains In progress.

Acceptance for this audit: verify exact owned GeoTools 34.5 / GeoWebCache 1.28.5 / GeoServer 2.28.5 source identities and declarations; inventory reactor/profile/plugin/repository inputs and GeoNode-required extensions; retain inspected source/build/license evidence with hashes; identify floating, missing and unretained dependencies with explicit fail-closed build prerequisites. Audit tooling must detect mismatched source identity and changed retained inputs. No Java build will be represented as complete before the selected closure is retained. Full-tuple, license/security, FND-07/FND-08 and P1 acceptance remain open.

The new owner GOV-02 observations in issue #9 are being reconciled independently on PR #52's existing branch; no importer rerun or merge is planned.

The bounded Java rendering dependency audit is reviewable in [PR #54](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/54), branch `fnd-02/java-dependency-audit`, verified head `c2ec4bfd37ba1afa789330972f103d0e6c977fdf`. Implemented/tested checkpoint: `514e90f41ddc12e5c2d03bd50ad339859d70beeb`; the final commit records PR/Project evidence only. Base is owner-merged Jupyter PR #53 at `12bd2c5c88ab8573add1b483f1d53b4024649b39`.

- Retained 70 audit inputs / 902,064,509 bytes: exact owned GT34.5/GWC1.28.5/GS2.28.5/GeoNode5.1.0 archives, Class B recipe/evaluation sources, original notices and hashed research responses. Manifest SHA256 `58afe0a757446e69e40ba3630f3361a464686254eca35ac691ef8cec4090957b`.
- Deterministic inventory accounts for 519 POMs and six Maven configurations, including deployment destinations. Actual audit **exit 1** preserves one inherited malformed archetype POM; complete file enumeration is not complete XML interpretation or effective dependency resolution.
- Printing requires unresolved MapFish `2.4-SNAPSHOT` source/artifact provenance or a deliberate tested fixed-source choice. Retained MapFish2.4.1 is only an evaluation candidate and declares GT34.4. Exact GeoNode recipe source exposes importer/WPS/profile and bootstrap-license questions.
- **28 audit/custody +175 package tests passed**, no failures/skips in the retained validation venv; strict plan/four schema checks passed. Independent inventory runs matched, actual GWC archive recovery matched its hash, and independent review findings were fixed/re-reviewed. Initial host-schema skips/failure are retained.

No Java build/native/runtime test ran; full Maven/toolchain custody, runtime compatibility, license/security, FND-07/FND-08/P1/P6 and the full product tuple remain unaccepted. Database/Jupyter native/runtime checks were not repeated; Jupyter custody was reverified unchanged.

FND-02 remains **In progress**, with Evidence now linked to PR #54 and supported readback retained. Next ready action: retain exact JDK/Maven and resolve the explicitly selected extension/source graph before controlled builds. [Exact findings](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/c2ec4bfd37ba1afa789330972f103d0e6c977fdf/plan/docs/java-dependency-audit.md) and [resumption record](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/c2ec4bfd37ba1afa789330972f103d0e6c977fdf/plan/docs/java-audit-handoff.md).

GOV-02 was separately reconciled in PR #52 and moved to In review after the new owner evidence; its documented roadmap limitation awaits PR review. Both PRs remain open and unmerged. No importer rerun, saved-view mutation, source-fork default, inherited workflow, secret, deployment or release change; no work remains running.

Continuing FND-02 toolchain custody and Maven dependency resolution on separate branch `fnd-02/java-toolchain-resolution`, worktree `ambisgis-platform-java-resolution`, based on PR #54 head `c2ec4bfd37ba1afa789330972f103d0e6c977fdf`. PR #54 remains open and unmerged; FND-02 remains In progress.

Acceptance for this bounded step: retain exact compatible JDK/Maven distributions, sources, notices and retrieval hashes; resolve an explicit core/GeoNode extension graph in a fresh task-local Maven repository through recorded acquisition; account for parent/BOM/plugin/test/source artifacts and every unresolved artifact; verify tamper detection and local replay. Source copies are disposable and donor workflows/deployment namespaces stay inactive. Printing snapshot provenance/fixed-source evaluation, extension bootstrap licensing and runtime compatibility remain explicit gates. No Java acceptance build or product/security/license approval is implied by dependency resolution.

FND-02 toolchain/dependency-resolution checkpoint is reviewable in PR #55, open and unmerged, stacked on audit PR #54. Branch: `fnd-02/java-toolchain-resolution`; implemented/tested checkpoint: `48b95a984dcf04ff52f4611f90e6219c6ad723cb`.

Retained Temurin 17.0.20.1+1 / Maven 3.9.16 with publisher sources/notices. Frozen custody verifies 34,118 files / 1,682,220,066 bytes, manifest SHA256 `2a9cc548d2d7709e39c6bef547e9befa7176a897fa6859a8bb7bae2ed14c7f07`. All 157 selected modules completed dependency acquisition and a fresh retained-file replay under actual IPv4/IPv6 socket denial; the normalized effective model matches. No Java compilation/native/runtime test ran.

140 custody/resolver tests and 175 package tests passed without failures/errors/skips; strict plan checks and four schema/example checks passed. Original failures and fixes are retained, including the XML resource checks, replay traversal failure, and missing SLF4J input exposed by actual offline execution.

The final source inventory exits 2 with 64 missing source classifiers; 16 missing-source GAVs occur at 33 direct declaration sites. Reconcile actual logging bindings/mediation, fixed MapFish/GeoFence alignment, remaining extension/bootstrap choices, schema rights and toolchain/native closure before acceptance builds. No dependency-conflict lock, full source closure or product acceptance is claimed.

Project Evidence now links PR #55; Delivery remains In progress and the other observed fields/archive state are unchanged. See the [handoff](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-toolchain-resolution/plan/docs/java-resolution-handoff.md) and [machine evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-toolchain-resolution/plan/verification/java-resolution.json). No source-fork default, workflow, secret, deployment or release changed. Next ready work is the recorded FND-02 source/provenance and compatibility gaps; client/MapStore and QGIS follow the dependency graph.

Continuing FND-02 on separate branch `fnd-02/java-source-compatibility`, worktree `ambisgis-platform-java-closure`, from corrected PR #55 head `9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98`. FND-02 remains In progress. PR #54 is reconciled with owner-merged GOV-02 main at `b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746`; both checkpoints preserve earlier commits and are separately reviewable. No PR was merged.

Acceptance for this bounded continuation: account for all 64 missing source-classifier records by actual coordinate/use, exact source or generated/resource correspondence, retained hashes and original rights evidence; implement verifiable recovery/closure checks; perform isolated real compilation/tests to resolve referencing/XML/importer and extension/logging uncertainties where prerequisites permit. Retain every failed probe, distinguish exploratory compilation from acceptance builds, and keep host/toolchain/source/legal/security gaps explicit. Required capabilities remain unchanged. Tracking reconciliation is a separate branch/PR.

Continuation checkpoint published in **PR #57**, branch `fnd-02/java-source-compatibility`, final tested head **`7d3063f89c20b5e028b0151a6648a79e4ef14a83`**, based on PR #55 at `9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98`. FND-02 remains **In progress**; no PR was merged and no product/source/legal/security baseline was approved.

The prior PRs are now reviewable: #54 integrates actual owner-merged main by normal merge, tested head `b15a785f350d347c0c2c4ff07ac6e5681c1d9746`; #55 normally incorporates that correction, tested head `9e1b2e1bca26d00b200a39f58a4a0890d43fca98`. Their updated summaries record bases, mergeability, validation and separate owner decisions. They are ordinary dependent branches, not a managed GitHub stack. Order: #54 first, then verify/retarget/retest #55, then verify/retarget/retest #57 against actual merged main. Never merge into an obsolete intermediate branch.

All 64 missing-classifier entries now have exact per-coordinate provenance/disposition: 39 retained-source structural candidates, four embedded-source entries, three generated-input entries and two metadata-only artifacts; **12 unresolved and four partial remain**. These 48 structurally accounted artifacts are not claimed reproducibly source-built. Exact JavaCSV/Huldra/JGridShift source was recovered and exercised. Marlin's tempting preceding source was compiled/disassembled and rejected as a match; other rights/source discrepancies remain explicit.

Actual results: GeoTools referencing 667 passed/eight skips; XML resolver 12 passed; GeoFence 62 passed including 27 real PostgreSQL/PostGIS tests; importer 112 passed/six Oracle-SQLServer fixture skips after all 89 selected modules compiled and all four GDAL transformations passed; Huldra 19 passed; JavaCSV 105 passed under explicit historical CRLF. JavaCSV's same 16 Linux-default failures reproduce against original and rebuilt binaries. MapFish compiles but 17 network-fixture error identities/six skips remain; broad XML retains one WireMock error/four skips. Logging mismatch and working aligned provider were both exercised. These are bounded component probes, not product acceptance.

At the exact final head: **212 Java tooling tests + 175 package tests + all four strict schemas passed without failures/skips**. Final guard verification rechecked 2,914 retained native files; failed attempts are preserved. Original Java-resolution snapshot remains unchanged. Historical database/Jupyter native suites were not rerun.

Separate tracking **PR #56** at `28c9d79757b98bdedd44b5d7486835f9e4b71e63` can be reviewed independently. The verified PR review queue contains the authorized existing #54/#55 as unarchived PR items, without Task ID/progress fields; 66 planned tasks +two PRs =68 items. Old views and this task's fields remain unchanged; GOV-02 was reconciled to Merged from actual owner merge #52. PRs #56/#57 were not added to Project because this session's narrow addition authorization names #54/#55 only. No UI action is pending.

**No owner decision is currently required for independent engineering; pending PR decisions gate merging only.** Next work: controlled loopback fixtures for XML/printing, exact remaining 16 source dispositions, combined GeoServer/GeoFence logging and OAuth/policy paths, schema repackaging/rights and host/toolchain closure.

[Current handoff](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-source-compatibility/plan/docs/java-source-closure-handoff.md), [source inventory](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-source-compatibility/plan/docs/java-source-provenance.md), [actual native evidence](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-source-compatibility/plan/docs/java-compatibility-evidence.md), [ADR 004](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/fnd-02/java-source-compatibility/plan/adrs/004-java-source-and-compatibility-probes.md). Raw retained archives and fresh runs remain under `/home/revelberry/Projects/AmbisGIS/source-archives` and `build-worktrees/java-compatibility`; exact-final-head check receipts are in `pr57-final-verification` there.
